data.title: Care grade (Pflegegrad) decision for the person's mother
data.summary: The Pflegekasse bei der Musterquell Krankenkasse informs Bastian Musterquell that, following the Medizinischer Dienst's assessment of 3 November 2026, his mother Edith Musterquell has been classified into care grade (Pflegegrad) 3 from 1 October 2026, entitling her to a monthly care allowance (Pflegegeld) of €599.00 while he and his sister provide home care. The letter also notes the next automatic debit for a separate contract (NE-3395-884) on 28 December 2026.
data.explanation: This is a decision (Bescheid) about your mother's level of care need. As long as you and your sister continue the home care, the fund pays a monthly allowance of €599; if you instead hire a professional care service, it bills the fund directly instead. If you think the classification is wrong, you may file an objection (Widerspruch) with the Pflegekasse — the app will show the deadline for this. If you do nothing, the decision becomes final after that period. The letter also reminds you of a routine automatic debit under a separate contract you have with them; make sure your account has sufficient funds.

key_facts.quote: Die nächste Abbuchung per Lastschrift erfolgt automatisch am 28.12.2026, in unveränderter Höhe.

items.title: Care grade (Pflegegrad) 3 takes effect
items.quote: nach dem Gutachten des Medizinischen Dienstes vom 03.11.2026 stufen wir Ihre Mutter ab dem 01.10.2026 in den Pflegegrad 3 ein.

items.title: Monthly care allowance (Pflegegeld)
items.action: No action needed as long as you and your sister continue providing the home care.
items.consequence: The allowance is paid only as long as you and your sister provide the home care yourselves; if a professional care service is used instead, it bills the fund directly and the allowance stops.
items.quote: Sie erhält damit monatlich ein Pflegegeld von 599,00 €, solange Sie und Ihre Schwester die Pflege zu Hause übernehmen.

items.title: Decide: home care or a professional care service
items.action: Decide whether you and your sister will keep providing the care yourselves or engage a professional care service (Pflegedienst) instead.
items.consequence: If you engage a care service, it will bill the Pflegekasse directly instead of you receiving the monthly care allowance.
items.quote: Wenn Sie stattdessen einen Pflegedienst beauftragen, rechnet er direkt mit uns ab.

items.title: Decide whether to object (Widerspruch) to the care grade decision
items.action: Decide whether you want to file an objection (Widerspruch) against the care grade decision if you believe it is incorrect.
items.consequence: If you do not act by the deadline shown, the decision becomes final (bestandskräftig).
items.quote: Innerhalb eines Monats ab Bekanntgabe kann gegen diesen Bescheid Widerspruch erhoben werden, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei: Pflegekasse bei der Musterquell Krankenkasse, Am Brunnenhof 2, 35390 Mustergießen.

items.title: Automatic debit for your other contract (NE-3395-884)
items.action: Make sure your account has sufficient funds for the automatic debit (Lastschrift).
items.quote: Die nächste Abbuchung per Lastschrift erfolgt automatisch am 28.12.2026, in unveränderter Höhe.
